steps.heading: Prepare your canvas
steps.caption: Start with the printed outline. Protect your table. Use thin coats; rinse and blot your brush between colors.

steps.heading: Turquoise background
steps.caption: Mix turquoise with a little white. Paint around the bouquet and vase with short, loose strokes. Let dry.

steps.heading: Block in the greenery
steps.caption: Mix green with a little brown. Fill leaves and spaces between flowers. Keep the petals, centers and berries white.

steps.heading: Paint the vase bands
steps.caption: Mix blue with a little black for navy. Alternate navy and white bands, starting at the top. Follow the curves; let dry.

steps.heading: Soft blush blooms
steps.caption: Mix white with a little rose red for blush. Fill the upper-left and lower-right blooms. Leave their centers white.

steps.heading: Warm apricot petals
steps.caption: Mix orange with white for apricot. Fill the upper-right flower with curved strokes. Leave its center white.

steps.heading: The rose-red flower
steps.caption: Use rose red for the five central petals. Pull strokes from each petal tip toward the center. Leave the center white.

steps.heading: Golden buds & centers
steps.caption: Mix yellow with a touch of brown for gold. Paint the small buds and all flower centers. Let every base coat dry.

steps.heading: Blend the petals
steps.caption: Shade pink with rose red; apricot with orange; red with rose red + brown. Add white to each for highlights. Feather wet edges with a clean, damp brush.

steps.heading: Leaf & vase highlights
steps.caption: Mix green + yellow for leaf highlights; blue + a little black + white for vase streaks; white + a speck of brown for white-band shadows. Follow the curves.

steps.heading: Berries & final details
steps.caption: Mix blue with a little black for berries. Add white to this mix for shine dots. Shade the yellow centers with brown; dot with yellow and white.

steps.heading: Dry flat & clean up
steps.caption: Let the completed canvas dry lying flat. Wash and reshape brushes, wipe your palette, and close the paint pots.
